cases.title: Record standard visited link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that visiting a standard URL records the link to the Global History.

cases.title: Attempt to record malformed URL to Global History
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to record a malformed or invalid URL to the Global History.

cases.title: Verify no history recording during Private Browsing mode
cases.description: Verify that links visited while in Private Browsing mode are not recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct redirected link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect, the correct final link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after multiple redirect hops
cases.description: Verify that the final target link is correctly recorded to Global History when a page goes through multiple server redirect hops.

cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes the corresponding URL to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Handle Dead or Blocked Links from History
cases.description: Verify abnormal behavior when clicking a history link that points to a dead URL or a blocked destination, ensuring proper error handling.

cases.title: Delete a single history entry
cases.description: Verify that a single selected history entry can be successfully deleted from the Global History.

cases.title: Delete the last remaining history entry
cases.description: Verify that deleting the very last remaining entry in the history list properly removes it and leaves an empty history state.

cases.title: Delete multiple selected history entries
cases.description: Verify that selecting multiple history entries and performing a delete action removes all selected entries from the history view.

cases.title: Delete all history entries simultaneously
cases.description: Verify the boundary scenario where all history entries present in the list are selected and deleted simultaneously, ensuring none are displayed afterward.

cases.title: Clear Entire Global History
cases.description: Verify that executing the clear Global History command removes all recorded history items from the browser history storage and UI.

cases.title: Clear Already Empty Global History
cases.description: Verify that attempting to clear the Global History when no items exist executes successfully without errors or adverse effects.

cases.title: Group history items by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped by Day in the history view.

cases.title: Group history items by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped by Site in the history view.

cases.title: Group history items by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed without grouping when the grouping option is set to None.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort History columns
cases.description: Verify that History columns can be sorted in ascending order and reverse-sorted in descending order when clicking column headers.

cases.title: Resize History Columns to Show and Hide Text
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be resized using the mouse to show more or hide parts of the entries.

cases.title: Resize History Columns to Minimum and Maximum Limits
cases.description: Verify boundary behavior when resizing history columns to their minimum and maximum allowed limits.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns via UI Toggles
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the UI column toggle controls.

cases.title: Re-visit site via Back button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Back button dropdown menu allows the user to select and re-visit a recently visited site.

cases.title: Re-visit site via Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Forward button dropdown menu allows the user to select and re-visit a site after navigating backwards.

cases.title: Empty Back and Forward dropdown history handling
cases.description: Verify the behavior of the Back and Forward button dropdown menus when there is no navigation history available, ensuring they are disabled or empty.

cases.title: Create new session history file on new browser window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created when a new browser window is opened.

cases.title: Create new session history file on browser restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created upon restarting the browser.

cases.title: Handle file creation permission error for session history file
cases.description: Verify the system handles file creation permission errors gracefully when attempting to create a new session history file.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases are comprehensive, well-structured, and adequately cover the distinct scenarios, edge cases, and risk areas for the given requirements. No blockers were identified.

All test cases map correctly to the specified requirements, but several cases (G-002, G-003, G-007, G-013, G-019, G-023, G-026) test edge cases, error conditions, or features like Private Browsing that are not supported or defined in the provided requirements list (R-073 to R-084). These unsupported boundary conditions make those specific cases untestable against the given requirement set.
confirmed_blockers: G-002 introduces a malformed URL test which is unsupported by R-073.
G-003 tests Private Browsing mode history exclusion, which is not mentioned in R-073.
G-007 tests dead or blocked links error handling, which is not specified in R-075.
G-013 tests clearing an already empty history, not defined in R-078.
G-019 tests min/max column resizing limits, which are not detailed in R-081.
G-023 tests disabled states for empty back/forward dropdowns, not covered by R-083.
G-026 tests file permission errors for session history creation, which is not specified in R-084.

analysis.analysis: Unit: firefox_browser_history. R-073: Normal scenario records standard visited links to Global History; boundary/abnormal scenarios involve malformed URLs or private browsing modes. R-074: Normal scenario records the final redirected URL; edge case involves multiple redirect hops. R-075: Normal scenario launches clicked link in browser window; abnormal scenario handles dead links or blocked URLs. R-076: Normal scenario deletes a single history entry; edge case deletes the last remaining entry. R-077: Normal scenario deletes multiple selected entries; boundary scenario deletes all entries simultaneously. R-078: Normal scenario clears entire Global History; edge case clears already empty history. R-079: Normal scenario groups by Day, Site, and None options. R-080: Normal scenario sorts and reverse-sorts each column. R-081: Normal scenario resizes columns to show and hide text; boundary scenario resizes columns to minimum and maximum limits. R-082: Normal scenario shows and hides history columns via UI toggles. R-083: Normal scenario re-visits sites using Back and Forward button dropdown menus; edge case handles empty dropdown history. R-084: Normal scenario creates a new empty session history file on browser restart or new window creation; edge case handles file creation permission errors.
